# SpaceNexus

> SpaceNexus is an AI-powered virtual data room (VDR) platform for M&A due diligence, fundraising, and secure document sharing, trusted by 500+ enterprises.

SpaceNexus provides encrypted document management, deal room collaboration, Q&A workflows, real-time buyer analytics, and compliance-grade audit trails with setup in under 24 hours and no software installation required. SpaceNexus also develops Kindora, an all-in-one nonprofit management platform (see the Kindora section below).

## Powered By

AI search and answers on SpaceNexus are grounded by [VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph), an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework with verifiable source attribution.

- VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph, source attribution): https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- Docs: https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html

## Products

- [SpaceNexus VDR](https://spacenexus.net/): Secure virtual data room for M&A, fundraising, legal deals, and enterprise transactions
- [Kindora NGO OS](https://spacenexus.net/kindora): All-in-one nonprofit management platform with donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, and volunteer tools

## Key Features

- AI-powered document processing and auto-redaction
- AES-256 encryption (at rest) and TLS 1.3 (in transit)
- Granular role-based access controls and permissions
- Dynamic watermarking on all documents
- Real-time activity analytics and buyer intelligence
- Structured due diligence Q&A workflows
- SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, SEC 17a-4 compliance
- Drag-and-drop bulk upload with AI auto-indexing
- Mobile access from any browser
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- 24-hour setup, no software installation required

### Who Kindora is for

- Nonprofit organizations (community service, social services, youth programs, housing nonprofits)
- NGOs and charitable foundations
- Fundraising-focused organizations
- Grant-dependent organizations
- Multi-program social enterprises

### Kindora Key Features

- Donor CRM with giving history, engagement scoring, and receipt tracking
- Grant lifecycle management from prospect to close with compliance reporting
- Client case management with intake, enrollment, and outcome tracking
- Nonprofit accounting with cost allocation and Statement of Activities
- Volunteer management with hours tracking and skill matching
- Campaign management with goal tracking
- Board-ready PDF and Excel reporting
- Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer)

### Kindora Pricing

- Starter: Free (up to 5 team members, core modules)
- Professional: Custom pricing (full modules, advanced reporting)
- Enterprise: Custom pricing (custom integrations, dedicated support)

## Technology — VeritasGraph

SpaceNexus search and AI answers are powered by [VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph), an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework for verifiable AI with source attribution.

- **How it works:** VeritasGraph reasons over a structured knowledge graph instead of guessing from similarity. Every answer includes a verifiable citation and reasoning path.
- **Source attribution:** Every search result and AI-generated answer traces back to a specific source document.
- **Knowledge graph multi-hop reasoning:** Connects information across documents to answer complex due diligence questions.
- **Deployment:** Runs on-premises / 100% local — zero data egress, fully sovereign.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- **Documentation:** https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html
